how: We read the website of every San Antonio wedding videographer listed on Lazo (79 listings, 64 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: photographers with no film work on their site, a nationwide DJ-and-video chain, an officiant and photo elopement service, venues and a portrait studio that the category lists. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Will you film the full ceremony, and do you record the vows and toasts on separate microphones?
How many hours are in the package, and what happens if the Hill Country drive or a late sunset pushes the timeline?
When do the highlight film and the full edit arrive, and are raw files available?

picks.name: Witte Idea
picks.blurb: Witte Idea's wedding business began with videography before growing into photo and video together, run by a San Marcos couple who met in a college art class. Candid and creative, with customizable wedding day packages.

picks.name: Solarshot Weddings - Photography And Videography
picks.blurb: Documentary photography and videography for San Antonio weddings from one team, so the stills and the film match. Solarshot Weddings books dates first come, first served and shares package details on inquiry.

picks.name: Gold Leader Films
picks.blurb: Michael Dean and Cassie of Gold Leader Films are based near Fredericksburg and film throughout San Antonio and the Hill Country, happy to travel wherever the story goes. They film little moments and real conversations rather than staged scenes, and work with planners and coordinators. Pricing on request.

picks.name: Celestial Wedding Video
picks.blurb: A San Antonio wedding filmmaking service that includes a full video of the ceremony and follows the day from getting ready onward. Celestial's packages are built around six, eight or ten hours of coverage; get in touch for pricing.

picks.name: Infinite Photography SA
picks.blurb: Mandy Kadura's Infinite Photography SA offers luxury wedding photography and videography in San Antonio, with an eye for detail and a love of natural light. Her aim is moments that feel real, timeless and meaningful rather than posed.

picks.name: Vista - Photo & Video
picks.blurb: Vista, founded by Steven Hernandez in Spring Branch, pairs wedding photography with cinematic film and builds the gallery around your vision over email, phone or Zoom. The goal is sharp, elegant and true to color, with Austin, Wimberley and Corpus Christi in range.

picks.name: Crazy Cool Studios
picks.blurb: Chris and Anthony Ramirez graduated from Full Sail University in 2005 and bring a combined 20 years in photography, videography and sound engineering to Crazy Cool Studios in San Antonio. Weddings are a specialty alongside music videos and portraits; watch the reel on the site.
